LESSON: FAMILY NEEDS AND WANTS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni
Topic 1.2: Family needs and wants
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Family needs and wants, part of SOCIAL ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we meet our basic needs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Family needs and wants together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: Interaction with digital technology skill is developed as learners manipulate digital devices to take photographs of

different places where family needs are met and sign them.

● Citizenship: Active community/family life skill is developed as learners reflect on different ways of meeting family needs and share with

others.

● Creativity and imagination: Originality skill is developed as learners draw and colour places where family needs are met.

Values:
● Respect: Learners enhance patience as they appreciate diverse opinions while sharing information on different ways of meeting family

needs.

● Responsibility: Learners develop a sense of responsibility as they appreciate various family needs and wants.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Health promotion issues: Health and hygiene is promoted as learners developed as learners appreciate ways of meeting family needs.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Mathematic Activities: Family needs and wants can be used to learn the skill of counting, sorting and grouping.

Suggested learning resources

Approved learning support materials ,Flash cards ,Pictures ,DLP devices ,Pictures of different foods, house and clothes, Foods such as flour,
